title: Torque
intro: Twenty minutes on the middle of you. Rotation first while you are fresh, then the bracing work that stops the hips and ribs cheating.
Slow beats fast on all of it. You are teaching the trunk to hold still while everything around it turns, which is what a forehand actually asks for.

before.label: Lower back
before.text: If your lower back is the problem, get it looked at first. The bodyweight back session in the Care list is there once someone has cleared you.

before.label: Stop and get it checked
before.text: Pain down a leg, numbness, weakness in a leg or foot, or numbness between your legs. If your bladder or bowel control changes, get seen the same day.

good: Enough to get warm, no more
Move slowly between the two shapes
Knees stacked and together, open the top arm
Feel the turn in the ribs

exercises.name: Glute Bridge

good: Push through the heels until the hips are level
bad: Arching the lower back at the top

exercises.note: Rotation gets its power from the hips, so wake them first.

good: Turn the ribs and keep the hips square
Squeeze the back glute to lock the hips
bad: The hips turning with the shoulders

exercises.name: Standing Chop

good: Chop from high on one side to low on the other
Let the back heel turn — the shot starts at the ground
bad: Arms only, with the feet glued to the floor

exercises.note: With a ball and a wall, throw it instead — same movement, more intent.

good: Feet wide, tap the opposite shoulder
bad: Hips swinging side to side with every tap

good: Straight line ankle to ear, hips stacked
Feel it down the bottom side
bad: Letting the top hip roll forward

good: Reach the opposite arm and leg long, not high
bad: Lifting the leg above hip height and arching
